discovery.title: AI-driven literature mining speeds discovery of heat-stable lead-free dielectric materials
discovery.summary: Artificial intelligence has analyzed data scattered across hundreds of research papers to discover new lead-free dielectric materials that maintain stable performance even at high temperatures. The study presents a new approach that could transform materials discovery from a trial-and-error process into a data-driven one.
